newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's economic performance index off 0.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Israel's economic performance index off 0.8 pct.

text.p: Israel's economic performance or "S" index fell 0.8 percent in December, the Bank of Israel said on Thursday.
For the full year, the index was up 3.7 percent, after rising 9.2 percent in 1995.

The "S" index is made up of four components: retail sales, which rose 3.6 percent in December; imports, which rose 0.3 percent in December; and industrial production, which lags behind the other sub-indices and fell 1.5 percent in November.
The bank did not provide a figure for the fourth component, work shifts.
Note: figures for the number of workers and industrial production lag.
